facts.fact: The park connects the Todaiji and Kasugataisha sectors; its approach is described east of Kintetsu-Nara and from JR Nara along Sanjo-dori.

facts.excerpt: d the park. A rickshaw ride is a relaxing experience, especially during the hot summer months. Getting to Nara Park Nara Park is a short walk east of Kintetsu-Nara Station . The area can also be reached by walking straight along Sanjo-dori Street from JR Nara Station , but takes roughly 20 minutes. Alternatively, hop on a bus. Nearly all city center buses make stops in and around the park.
